title: Workspace Brand Core asset materialization with durable provenance

phases.objective: Turn an already-known active Brand Core context source into a durable workspace asset with canonical tenant/Brand/Brand-Workspace authority, queryable provenance identity, exact transactional readback, and truthful nullable content checksum semantics without fetching provider content.

e2e_journeys.actor: Authenticated workspace owner/admin or delegated Brand editor/manager
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Exactly one active Brand Core source belonging to the canonical tenant Brand is resolved, materialized idempotently into workspace_assets with Brand Workspace ownership plus source/provenance identity, read back under lock before commit, and classified as a governed state change; content_sha256 remains null unless a real content hash exists.
steps: Require Migration 1050 provenance schema before any materialization write.
Authenticate through canonical User JWT middleware rather than Resource API fallback JWT compatibility.
Resolve Brand authority through the existing canonical Brand asset authority helper and require the canonical Brand Workspace binding.
Resolve exactly one active/validated Brand Core source by stable asset/doc/file/Google identity inside the canonical Brand.
Normalize source identity to asset_key, doc_key, or Google file identity and derive source_ref_sha256.
Derive provenance_sha256 from tenant, Brand Workspace, canonical Brand, source identity, source revision, and validation status.
Persist or idempotently refresh one workspace_assets row through the unique provenance key without provider content fetch.
Keep content_sha256 null when no actual content digest exists instead of hashing metadata and calling it content.
Read back exact persisted workspace/Brand/source/provenance fields under lock before commit and roll back on mismatch.
Generate operation-governance and frontend/OpenAPI evidence from the final exact source tree.
assertions: Legacy Brand Core rows with only a Google document/file identity can still produce a deterministic source_ref.
Missing/ambiguous/inactive Brand Core sources fail closed.
Missing/ambiguous Brand Workspace authority fails closed.
Retry converges on the same provenance identity rather than producing duplicate persisted assets.
The provenance dedupe index uses source_ref_sha256 rather than indexing an unbounded source_ref string.
Provider content is not fetched and content_sha256 is not fabricated from provenance metadata.
The generated operation rule is state_change only when canonical JWT, Brand authority, schema, source identity, transaction/readback and registered test evidence all pass.
No Migration Apply, Production/Hostinger/provider mutation, deployment, credential/secret access, force push or external send occurs in CI.
